text:
Lina (compliance): Auditor request landed: they need evidence that after the RBAC change we redacted PII from app logs, that exported logs were envelope-encrypted with KMS, and that the export is tamper-evident with per-file hashes. Also include vuln-triage linking CVEs to commits and the IR ticket (2026-IR-47). Can we assemble by EOD?

Maria (sec-eng): Yep. I will prepare redaction rules, sanitized samples, a per-file manifest (JSONL), and a GPG-signed manifest. Quick question: auditor wants per-file hashes or just a single bundle hash?

auditor_jones: Per-file sha256s please. Also provide a short chain-of-custody statement (who exported, timestamp, KMS key & version) and evidence redaction occurred before export.

Ajay (infra): I will run the export pipeline and envelope-encrypt each object. Plan:
- S3 path: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/
- Set object metadata: exported-by, exported-at, kms-key-id, kms-key-version
- Compute sha256 for each .log.enc and write manifest.jsonl (one JSON object per line)
- Sign manifest with GPG (manifest.jsonl.sig)

Sam (sec-ops): Note: RBAC change created two ephemeral service accounts (svc-rw-data, svc-metrics). We rotated their credentials during the window; include iam-change.diff and rotation events. IR ticket is 2026-IR-47 (token leak alert).

Maria (sec-eng): Redaction rules used (applied by our log-processor, CI-verified):
```
# redact emails and SSN-like patterns
s/email\S*@\S+/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g
s/\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/[REDACTED_SSN]/g
# redact header user ids
s/(user_id=)[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/\1[REDACTED_ID]/g
```
Sample sanitized line:
```
2026-03-20T15:02:13Z svc-api request_id=abc123 user_id=[REDACTED_ID] email=[REDACTED_EMAIL] action=get-embedding duration_ms=42
```
Deterministic: same regex set + fixed processing order in CI; will include redact_test.py so auditor can replay.

Ajay (infra): Export command I ran for traceability:
```
aws s3 cp --recursive /var/log/processed/ s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/ --metadata exported-by=ajay,exported-at=2026-03-20T15:10:00Z
```
I envelope-encrypted each file with KMS and added per-object metadata: kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234, kms-key-version 3. Hashing snippet:
```
for f in *.log.enc; do sha256sum "$f" >> manifest.jsonl; done
```
Signing:
```
gpg --output manifest.jsonl.sig --sign manifest.jsonl
```

ops-bot: Export completed: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/ (12 files) :white_check_mark:

auditor_jones: Good. Please include gpg public key (gpg_pubkey.asc), a copy or snippet of the KMS key policy showing principals who can Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, and an exported JSON of the IAM change event (before/after bindings). Also provide vuln-triage.csv linking CVE -> component -> PR/commit -> remediation -> verification.

Maria (sec-eng): Will attach KMS policy snippet and gpg_pubkey.asc. Vuln triage sample row I'll add: CVE-2026-0421, tokenizer-lib, commit abcdef1, pinned to 1.2.3 + sanitization test, verified in staging 2026-03-18.

Sam (sec-ops): I'll attach the IR timeline PDF and link the bundle to 2026-IR-47 for chain-of-custody.

Maria (sec-eng): Example manifest.jsonl line (actual SHA256s will be inserted):
{"file":"svc-api-2026-03-20.log.enc","sha256":"<hex>","exported_by":"ajay","exported_at":"2026-03-20T15:10:00Z","kms_key_id":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-1234","kms_key_version":"3","signed_by":"maria"}
I'll also prepare a human-readable audit-note.txt stating: "Exported and redacted prior to export; manifest signed; KMS key ver 3 used" with timestamp + signer and sign that too.

auditor_jones: Also want a short explanation of why redaction is deterministic (to allow replay) and the test harness usage.

Maria (sec-eng): Deterministic because we run the same regex rules in the same order under CI-controlled runtime; redact_test.py + sample raw/expected files will validate. Example usage:
```
$ python redact_test.py samples/raw.log samples/expected_sanitized.log
OK
```

Ajay (infra): KMS policy snippet (sanitized):
{"KeyId":"abcd-1234","Policy":{"Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowEncrypt","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/infra-exporter"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Effect":"Allow"},{"Sid":"AllowDecrypt","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/sec-ops"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Effect":"Allow"}]}}

Maria (sec-eng): Bundle contents (2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip): samples/raw_and_sanitized_examples/, manifest.jsonl, manifest.jsonl.sig, iam-change.diff, cloud-audit-event.json, ir-2026-IR-47-timeline.pdf, vuln-triage.csv, redact_test.py, gpg_pubkey.asc, audit-note.txt, README-mapping-to-SOC-controls.md. I'll map files to CC6/CC7 in the README.

Sam (sec-ops): Uploading bundle and will add a comment linking it to IR ticket 2026-IR-47.

ops-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip (signed) :package:

auditor_jones: Received. We'll validate per-file sha256 against manifest and verify the GPG signature. If anything else is needed we'll ping. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Lina (compliance): Great. Please mark the items as "evidence:prepared" in the compliance tracker once uploaded. Thanks everyone.
